changelog:
> **Changes :**

**- Bug Fixes / Optimizations  :** Reduced APK/APP size from 240MB to 130MB, Optimized the app for low-end and high-end devices, Fixed excessive lag in some heavy screens, Fixed multiple bugs & issues (Karaoke, UI text clipping, Top App bar, Catalog, Music Player, Web search, AI assistant, BMI screen...)

**- New Features :** New languages (French, Spanish, Brazilian-Protuguese), Ability to toggle top app bar descriptions, Switched over to a Mic-less audio visualizer for NowPlaying (MusicPlayer's FullPlayerView), Added Markdown support to the Update overlay changelogs...
